action_inputs.description: OpenSCAP profile id or its ending. Empty lets the scan pick the first of the Compliance settings page's default profiles that the server's own guide offers.
action_inputs.label: Profile

action_inputs.description: How long provisioning may wait for all of the job's scans together; a scan still running then is cancelled and the servers left are skipped. Empty uses 30.
